Statistical measurements of body dimensions; design typically accommodates 5th-95th percentile range; Henry Dreyfuss Designing for People 1955 set standards.
Static measures stationary body; dynamic captures reach, range of motion and clearance during movement.

walkthroughs.body_html:
Human Factors & Ergonomics — a core area of Design Technology.

Working through it builds the schema you need: the key terms, how they connect, and how to use them together.

Human Factors & Ergonomics brings together several ideas you need to use as a set, not in isolation.

Lock in the vocabulary first, then practise pulling the ideas together to answer real questions.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with Human Factors & Ergonomics.

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.
